title: Crash while trying to render SVG plots with matplotlib
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

Hi.

Invoking `streamlit.pyplot(..., format="svg")` crashes with matplotlib plots.


### Reproducible Code Example

[![Open in Streamlit Cloud](https://static.streamlit.io/badges/streamlit_badge_black_white.svg)](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/?issue=gh-11489)

```Python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import streamlit

streamlit.set_page_config(page_title="Crash")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(30, 15))
streamlit.pyplot(fig, format="svg")
```

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Run `streamlit run my_page.py`
2. Open web browser
3. Crash

### Expected Behavior

The plot to be rendered in SVG, not blurry.

### Current Behavior

Crash
```

Traceback (most recent call last):

    result = func()

    exec(code, module.__dict__)
  File "my_page.py", line 8, in <module>
    streamlit.pyplot(fig, format="svg")
  File "streamlit\runtime\metrics_util.py", line 444, in wrapped_func
    result = non_optional_func(*args, **kwargs)
  File "streamlit\elements\pyplot.py", line 125, in pyplot
    marshall(
  File "streamlit\elements\pyplot.py", line 180, in marshall
    marshall_images(
  File "streamlit\elements\lib\image_utils.py", line 442, in marshall_images
    proto_img.url = image_to_url(
  File "streamlit\elements\lib\image_utils.py", line 334, in image_to_url

  File "streamlit\elements\lib\image_utils.py", line 188, in _ensure_image_size_and_format
    pil_image: PILImage = Image.open(io.BytesIO(image_data))
  File "PIL\Image.py", line 3281, in open
    raise UnidentifiedImageError(msg)
PIL.UnidentifiedImageError: cannot identify image file b'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" standalone="no"?>\n<!DOCTYPE svg PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD SVG 1.1//EN"\n  "http://www.w3.org/Graph'
```


### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.45.0
- Python version: 3.10
- Operating System: Windows
- Browser: any (using chrome)


### Additional Information

_No response_

Hi [USER] thanks for filing this issue. I can confirm this is reproducible in the latest nightly of streamlit.
For anyone else running into this, we suggest using a different value such as `png` for this parameter.
I think streamlit.pyplot does not support svg format. it only work for binary images. wither remove svg or use st.components.v1.html for svg
